overview_description.description:
DUPLAYS organises sport & social activities in 8 cities with over 60,000 members. They deliver great sport, fitness and team building activities where you live. Join us for nightly leagues, weekend tournaments, high-profile events, employee engagement programs and more!

Founded in 2007 by expats looking to get active and meet others in Dubai. DUPLAYS grew from 20 friends playing ultimate frisbee to over 60,000 members across 8 cities playing 20+ recreational sports. 

They believe you don't need to go to bars to meet new people and that you don't need a gym membership to get fit. Their goal is to make communities healthier, more social and more connected through sport.
